title: After every step is Completed the wizard renders a summary-review surface with one summary-list section per step and a Change link per row that retains every other answer on save
asA: operator who has finished every step in the wizard
iWant: a summary-review surface that lists every step's answers as a definition list, with a Change link per row that takes me back to the step with the field focused, and my other answers still present when I save
soThat: I can review everything I entered before I submit, revise a single answer without losing the rest, and satisfy myself the submission is what I intended

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given every step is Completed, /summary renders [data-surface="summary-review"] with one [data-summary-list-section] per step; each section holds a <dl> summary list carrying [data-summary-row] entries with a <dt> label and a <dd> value; every row carries a [data-recovery="change"] link whose href routes back to the step. After clicking a Change link, editing that field and saving, the operator returns to /summary and every other row's value is preserved verbatim. The pack drives /summary, reads the row count and dl structure, follows one Change link, updates one field, saves, and diffs the summary rows before and after to prove only the edited row changed.
